changes.title: deniedMcpServers.serverUrl description changed (+232 −98 chars)
changes.text_diff:
@@ -1,1 +1,1 @@
-URL pattern with wildcard support (e.g., "https://*.example.com/*") for blocked remote MCP servers
+URL pattern with wildcard support (e.g., "https://*.example.com/*") for blocked remote MCP servers. A pattern with no query also blocks the URL with any query, or with a trailing slash added or, if its path has no wildcard, removed.

after.description: When true in managed settings, Claude Code lists and loads no skill of an MCP server that it connects to directly, reads no listed file of a loaded one, and lists no directory of the server. On the Team and Enterprise plans these skills are off unless an administrator sets it to false. Connectors that Claude Code reaches through Anthropic keep their skills, and each server keeps its tools. In a user, project or local settings file it has no effect.

# Check for rg availability
if ! hash rg 2>/dev/null && ! typeset -f rg >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  function rg {
  if [[ -x <install>/claude ]]; then
  if [[ -n ${ZSH_VERSION:-} ]]; then
    ARGV0=rg <install>/claude ${1+"$@"}
  elif [[ "$OSTYPE" == "msys" ]] || [[ "$OSTYPE" == "cygwin" ]] || [[ "$OSTYPE" == "win32" ]]; then
    ARGV0=rg <install>/claude ${1+"$@"}
  else
    (exec -a rg <install>/claude ${1+"$@"})
  fi
  elif [[ -x <home>/.local/bin/claude ]]; then
  if [[ -n ${ZSH_VERSION:-} ]]; then
    ARGV0=rg <home>/.local/bin/claude ${1+"$@"}
  elif [[ "$OSTYPE" == "msys" ]] || [[ "$OSTYPE" == "cygwin" ]] || [[ "$OSTYPE" == "win32" ]]; then
    ARGV0=rg <home>/.local/bin/claude ${1+"$@"}
  else
    (exec -a rg <home>/.local/bin/claude ${1+"$@"})
  fi
  else command rg ${1+"$@"}; fi
}
fi
# Shadow find/grep with embedded bfs/ugrep
unalias find 2>/dev/null || true
unalias grep 2>/dev/null || true
function find {
  if [[ -x <install>/claude ]]; then
  if [[ -n ${ZSH_VERSION:-} ]]; then
    ARGV0=bfs <install>/claude -S dfs -regextype findutils-default ${1+"$@"}
  elif [[ "$OSTYPE" == "msys" ]] || [[ "$OSTYPE" == "cygwin" ]] || [[ "$OSTYPE" == "win32" ]]; then
    ARGV0=bfs <install>/claude -S dfs -regextype findutils-default ${1+"$@"}
  else
    (exec -a bfs <install>/claude -S dfs -regextype findutils-default ${1+"$@"})
  fi
  elif [[ -x <home>/.local/bin/claude ]]; then
  if [[ -n ${ZSH_VERSION:-} ]]; then
    ARGV0=bfs <home>/.local/bin/claude -S dfs -regextype findutils-default ${1+"$@"}
  elif [[ "$OSTYPE" == "msys" ]] || [[ "$OSTYPE" == "cygwin" ]] || [[ "$OSTYPE" == "win32" ]]; then
    ARGV0=bfs <home>/.local/bin/claude -S dfs -regextype findutils-default ${1+"$@"}
  else
    (exec -a bfs <home>/.local/bin/claude -S dfs -regextype findutils-default ${1+"$@"})
  fi
  else command find ${1+"$@"}; fi
}
function grep {
  local _cc_a
  for _cc_a in ${1+"$@"}; do
    case "$_cc_a" in -*-filter*|-*-pager*|-*-view*|-*-format-open*|-*-config*|---*|-@*|-*-save-config*|-[Zz]*|-[!-]*[Zz]*|--null|--null-data) command grep ${1+"$@"}; return ;; esac
  done
  if [[ -x <install>/claude ]]; then
  if [[ -n ${ZSH_VERSION:-} ]]; then
    ARGV0=ugrep <install>/claude -G --ignore-files --hidden -I --encoding=UTF-8 --exclude-dir=.git --exclude-dir=.svn --exclude-dir=.hg --exclude-dir=.bzr --exclude-dir=.jj --exclude-dir=.sl ${1+"$@"}
  elif [[ "$OSTYPE" == "msys" ]] || [[ "$OSTYPE" == "cygwin" ]] || [[ "$OSTYPE" == "win32" ]]; then
    ARGV0=ugrep <install>/claude -G --ignore-files --hidden -I --encoding=UTF-8 --exclude-dir=.git --exclude-dir=.svn --exclude-dir=.hg --exclude-dir=.bzr --exclude-dir=.jj --exclude-dir=.sl ${1+"$@"}
  else
    (exec -a ugrep <install>/claude -G --ignore-files --hidden -I --encoding=UTF-8 --exclude-dir=.git --exclude-dir=.svn --exclude-dir=.hg --exclude-dir=.bzr --exclude-dir=.jj --exclude-dir=.sl ${1+"$@"})
  fi
  elif [[ -x <home>/.local/bin/claude ]]; then
  if [[ -n ${ZSH_VERSION:-} ]]; then
    ARGV0=ugrep <home>/.local/bin/claude -G --ignore-files --hidden -I --encoding=UTF-8 --exclude-dir=.git --exclude-dir=.svn --exclude-dir=.hg --exclude-dir=.bzr --exclude-dir=.jj --exclude-dir=.sl ${1+"$@"}
  elif [[ "$OSTYPE" == "msys" ]] || [[ "$OSTYPE" == "cygwin" ]] || [[ "$OSTYPE" == "win32" ]]; then
    ARGV0=ugrep <home>/.local/bin/claude -G --ignore-files --hidden -I --encoding=UTF-8 --exclude-dir=.git --exclude-dir=.svn --exclude-dir=.hg --exclude-dir=.bzr --exclude-dir=.jj --exclude-dir=.sl ${1+"$@"}
  else
    (exec -a ugrep <home>/.local/bin/claude -G --ignore-files --hidden -I --encoding=UTF-8 --exclude-dir=.git --exclude-dir=.svn --exclude-dir=.hg --exclude-dir=.bzr --exclude-dir=.jj --exclude-dir=.sl ${1+"$@"})
  fi
  else command grep ${1+"$@"}; fi
}
# Shadow pkill to refuse patterns matching the CLI process
unalias pkill 2>/dev/null || true
function pkill {
  if [ -n "${CLAUDE_PID:-}" ] && [ -r "/proc/${CLAUDE_PID}/comm" ]; then
    local _cc_skip="" _cc_a
    local -a _cc_probe=()
    for _cc_a in ${1+"$@"}; do
      if [ -n "$_cc_skip" ]; then _cc_skip=""; continue; fi
      case "$_cc_a" in
        --signal) _cc_skip=1 ;;
        --signal=*|-e|--echo) ;;
        -[0-9]*) ;;
        -[PUGOF]?*) _cc_probe+=("$_cc_a") ;;
        -[ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ][ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ0-9]*) ;;
        *) _cc_probe+=("$_cc_a") ;;
      esac
    done
    if command pgrep ${_cc_probe[@]+"${_cc_probe[@]}"} 2>/dev/null | command grep -qx "${CLAUDE_PID}"; then
      printf 'pkill: refusing to run — this pattern matches the Claude CLI process (PID %s). Narrow the pattern, or target your own children with `pkill -P $$ ...`.\n' "${CLAUDE_PID}" >&2
      return 1
    fi
  fi
  command pkill ${1+"$@"}
}
